Ephemera, at least in a specific context, is an energized sand-like substance throughout Zereth Mortis. Within the Sepulcher of the First Ones, Principle Architect Lihuvim weaves ephemera into being in accordance with the hallowed will of the First Ones. In the canyon known as the Ephemeral Plains, Halondrus the Reclaimer fulfills its sacred purpose of reclaiming ephemera and returning it to the great cycle. Nearby, as Skolex consumes vast amounts of ephemera, the Sepulcher is thrown out of balance and threatens to collapse upon itself.
